title: Define auditable color derivative and typography variance spec
creator: Aisha Morton
acceptance_criteria: A token generation script produces a colors.json with provenance metadata for every derived color (seed, transformation, contrast check results)
Typography variance spec includes a 4-step responsive scale and explicit deltas for compact/dense modes with examples for tables and chart labels
All color pairs used in primary interactive components meet AA contrast or have documented overrides with justification and test vectors
Migration guide and codemod outline exist and a phasing plan is agreed with Platform (Dedicated) for rollout
A Figma library export and a runtime CSS variables bundle are published and validated in a smoke test app
comments: 2026-02-12 — Kickoff: aligned with PM on scope: color derivatives (seed-based), a small, auditable provenance format, and a typography variance sheet for dense data surfaces (tables/charts). Agreed to prioritize auditability over minimal bundle size for the first iteration.

2026-02-18 — Research: prototyped a seed->derivative pipeline (lighten/darken/HSL shifts + perceptual contrast checks). Early output included metadata keys: seed, transform, contrast_AA, contrast_AAA, generation_tool_version. Shared results with Eng for perf evaluation.

2026-02-22 — Engineering feedback (Lucien): prefers derivation done at build-time (token generation step) to avoid runtime compute on Dedicated. Raised concern about increased artifact size; suggested gzipped JSON and optional pruning of unused derivatives per deploy.

2026-02-25 — Accessibility review (Marta): flagged that some semantic accents when combined with compact table rows fall below 4.5:1 at small sizes. Action: add contrast-override tokens for table-cell-primary-on-accent and document the guardrails in the PRD.

2026-03-02 — Design review: added explicit 'density deltas' for typography (compact, cozy, default, spacious). Each delta includes font-size, line-height, letter-spacing and vertical rhythm examples for chart axis labels and table cells.

2026-03-05 — Trade-off decision: two naming systems considered — semantic (accent-primary/neutral-...) vs algorithmic (seed-01, seed-01-20L). Chosen hybrid: semantic tokens that reference a generated derivative id. Rationale: readable in code + traceable provenance.

2026-03-09 — PM note (Ravi): requested a rollout plan that gates the change behind a feature flag for platform customers with strict theming requirements. Added to dependencies: ENG-4021 (feature-flag rollout) and PM-211 (enterprise comms).

2026-03-11 — PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8793 includes the generator, sample tokens.json with provenance fields, and the typography variance markdown. Seeking design + eng signoff on naming and acceptance criteria.

2026-03-12 — Review feedback from Visual QA: shadow density mapping needs samples at 3 elevations for compact cards used in dashboards. Added shadow tokens: shadow-compact-1..3 and mapping guidance for elevation vs z-index.

Follow-ups: create codemod that replaces legacy tokens with new semantic references, add test set that renders table examples with automated contrast snapshots, and schedule a short rollout demo with selected customers.
decision_rationale: Generate derivatives at build-time to minimize runtime overhead on Dedicated and Private deployments
Include provenance metadata per derived token to make audits and regression analysis straightforward for security/compliance teams
Adopt a hybrid naming convention so tokens are human-readable while still linking back to an algorithmic generation record
Provide explicit typography deltas rather than purely calculated scales to ensure predictable rendering in dense UI (tables/charts) across browsers
implementation_notes: Token generator will be a Node script (tokens/generate-derivatives.js) that outputs tokens/colors.json; include versioned schema and sample payloads
Produced JSON will include: id, semantic_name, seed_id, transform_command, contrast_AA, contrast_AAA, generated_at, generator_version
Expose runtime via CSS custom properties for hosted customers; Platform/Dedicated will consume a precompiled CSS bundle to avoid runtime computation
Typography sheet to be published as markdown + Figma styles with explicit numeric deltas for compact/cozy/default/spacious
Shadow/elevation mapping: three compact elevations and five global elevations; include px/rgba tokens and an accessibility note about motion/opacity for reduced-motion users
migration_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Release tokens.json + CSS bundle behind a feature flag for internal apps and two partner customers
Phase 2 (codemod): Ship codemod that replaces legacy token references in the monorepo; run against web-app/console and admin-dashboard
Phase 3 (wider rollout): Enable feature flag gradually for all hosted customers and provide migration docs for Dedicated/Private operators
Rollbacks: keep previous tokens bundle available and a fallback mapping for legacy token names for one release window
